title: Regional Poverty Alleviation Partnership and E-Commerce Trade
authors: Zemin Zhong; Wenyu Zhou; Jiewei Li; Peng Li
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. City-pair gravity regressions and a spatial RD (Tables 2-7): reghdfe y lndist partnership, absorb(excity#month imcity#month [ex_seg100#im_seg100]) where partnership is a time-invariant pair indicator (verified in shipped data: no within-pair variation over the 60 months 2017-2021; 256 of 19,140 directed pairs partnered). Identification is cross-sectional (partnered vs non-partnered pairs within segment cells). Table 5 col 11 interacts partnership with a single-date pandemic 'post' (2020-01). The shipped data are synthetic.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). Gravity model with exporter-city x month and importer-city x month FE plus log distance; 'spatial RD' adds exporter-segment x importer-segment FE (100-km segments); heterogeneity via partnership x city characteristics; mechanisms (migration, Baidu search, subsidies).

specs.exclusion_reason: time-invariant pair-level partnership indicator; cross-sectional gravity/spatial-RD comparison, no adoption timing
partnership x single-date pandemic post interaction (heterogeneity), not staggered
subgroup-by-treatment interactions on the cross-sectional partnership indicator

data_files_note: ReadMe.pdf lists Main_Regression_Data.dta as synthetic data (1,148,400 directed city-pair-months).
data_provenance_note: Authors label the main regression data synthetic (Alibaba trade data not shareable).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Time-invariant treatment and synthetic data; ineligible on design and data.
